Description: Ultimate Twitch Viewer Plugin (Live Avatars, Auto-Rotating Live Slots, Live Switcher, Quick Chat !lurk & MultiTwitch)

com.community.twitchviewer.streamer.Name: Favorite Streamer (Live Status)
com.community.twitchviewer.streamer.Tooltip: Displays streamer avatar (Grayscale = Offline, Color = Live + 100% Optional Badges)

com.community.twitchviewer.autoslot.Name: Dynamic Live Slot (Auto-Rotate)
com.community.twitchviewer.autoslot.Tooltip: Displays currently live followed channels with automatic rotation

com.community.twitchviewer.autopage.Name: Dynamic Live Switcher (Next)
com.community.twitchviewer.autopage.Tooltip: Shows total live count & cycles all Dynamic Live Slots on press

com.community.twitchviewer.chatmacro.Name: Quick Chat / !lurk (Channel Icon)
com.community.twitchviewer.chatmacro.Tooltip: Shows channel avatar & sends !lurk or custom message on short press

com.community.twitchviewer.multitwitch.Name: MultiTwitch Split-Screen
com.community.twitchviewer.multitwitch.Tooltip: Opens 2 to 4 streams side-by-side in a single split-screen window
